path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

objective.description: The concrete objective. Observable and verifiable (e.g. 'all tests in packages/x pass', 'PR #5 review comments addressed'). Max 500 chars.

token_budget.description: Optional token budget. Omit unless the user asked for a cap. The goal stops (budget_limited) once cumulative tokens reach this value.

status.description: With mode "status": the proposed terminal status.

summary.description: One or two sentences: the evidence you believe proves the proposal. Treated as untrusted input by the verifier.

safety_refusal.description: True only when the objective cannot be pursued within safety/policy bounds.

token_budget.description: With mode "token_budget": the new cap, or null to clear.

expected_goal_id.description: With mode "token_budget": goal id from a fresh get_goal.

expected_updated_at.description: With mode "token_budget": updated_at from the same get_goal.

status.description: Current status: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled

todos.description: The complete task list snapshot (replaces the previous list).

item_id.description: The item id from the plan

dispatched.description: Mark dispatched (first report before results arrive).

task.description: One-line description of the overall graph task.

instruction.description: Bounded, self-contained instruction for the item.

depends_on.description: Item ids whose committed results this item consumes.

summary.description: The committed result (≤400 chars) — downstream items receive it verbatim.

dispatched.description: Mark dispatched (first call before results arrive).

prompt.description: Description of the image. Be specific.

image.description: Source image: local file path, data: URL, or base64.

model.description: Override as "provider/model-id" (must accept an image and output one).

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

title.description: Short 3-8 word title shown to the user

task.description: Complete, self-contained instructions. The subagent does not see this conversation: include the goal, relevant paths, constraints, and what to report back.

profile.description: Profile name. Available: subagent_explore — Read-only codebase exploration and research.; subagent_general — General-purpose tasks including code changes.; explore — Read-only exploration agent for parallel file reads and searches.; work — Write-capable worker agent with transparent file locking.. Custom agents added later are listed in the Subagents section of the system prompt.

is_background.description: Run without waiting; report arrives via notification (default false)

resume.description: agent_id of an earlier subagent to continue (keeps its context); always runs in the foreground

agent_id.description: Subagent or sidekick id; omit for the most recent

name.description: Short human-readable task name shown in the bg footer dock. Required; use 2-6 words, not the raw command.

command.description: Shell command to start in the background

isAgent.description: True ONLY when the command launches an LLM/agent process (enables telemetry wrapping). False for scripts, tests, servers, sleeps.

timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the task after this many seconds (optional)

notifyOnCompletion.description: Deliver a durable terminal notification when the task finishes. Default true for finite tasks. Set false or pair with triggerOnCompletion:false for persistent servers/daemons/watchers.

triggerOnCompletion.description: Start a follow-up agent turn on terminal notification. Default true for finite tasks (tests, builds, exports). MUST set false for persistent background services/servers (e.g. dev servers, watchers) so the harness and subagents do not wait indefinitely for the server to finish. Requires notifyOnCompletion.

taskId.description: Task ID or unambiguous prefix. Omit to list all tasks.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes of output to return (1-30720). Default 30720.

tail.description: Read from the end (tail, default true) or the beginning (head)

taskId.description: Task ID or unambiguous prefix of a running task

source.description: Provider selection (1=wigolo, 2=DuckDuckGo, 3=Jina Search, 4=SerpAPI, 5=Tavily, 6=Perplexity). Omit for auto-selection.

anyOf.description: Array of URLs to read in batch

url.description: URL or array of URLs to read

source.description: Provider selection (0=smart-fetch engine, 1=wigolo, 2=Jina Reader, 3=Firecrawl, 4=Perplexity). Default is 0 (smart-fetch).

browser.description: TLS fingerprint browser profile (e.g., chrome_145). Default: chrome_145.

os.description: OS fingerprint (windows, macos, linux). Default: windows.

removeImages.description: Strip image references from content. Default: false.

batchConcurrency.description: Concurrent requests for batch mode. Default: 8.

verbose.description: Include metadata header in output. Default: true.

prompt.description: Custom summarization prompt. Omit for default comprehensive summary.

source.description: Provider selection for content fetch (1=Perplexity, 2=LLM summarize). Omit for auto-selection.

description.description: What this option means or its trade-offs

value.description: Returned instead of the label when set

action.description: end_turn: stop the turn when picked · new_session: hand off to `prefill` (compact & run / run directly)

prefill.description: Message or /command queued by a new_session option

options.description: 2–4 choices. An "Other" free-text choice is added automatically.

multi_select.description: Let the user pick several (default false)

query.description: What to recall, in plain keywords (e.g. 'redis cache decision'). Multi-word queries are ranked by relevance. A regex pattern also works. #N:path drills into a file's content from an entry.

expand.description: Entry indices to return full untruncated content for

page.description: Page number (1-based) for paginated search results. Default: 1.

scope.description: Default 'lineage' covers the active conversation path. Use 'all' to also reach messages from other branches, such as turns that were edited or retried.

mode.description: What to show. hybrid (default) = normal search; touched = aggregated files-by-path with entry indices.
